scope: Read-only diagnosis of default v5 method assembly and actual Demo frozen inputs; no code repair or semantic modeling start.
design: 2026-10-26 methodology design section 2 explicitly retains the multiview unified semantic graph and ontology-modeling method as baseline.
facts: The v5 method includes generic S0-S9 and semantic-record responsibilities; it is not devoid of semantic guidance.
Role declarations and generic resource kinds still support multiple perspectives.
Detailed v4 action/process/rule/interface sections and equivalent active multiview method are absent from the actual Demo frozen input.
The v5 namespace does not stage ontology-modeling; actual native inventories show all five ambient Skills disabled.
Generic source-to-model self-check and independent evaluator instructions exist; prior factual omissions show these checks did not reliably detect gaps.

diagnosis.change_surface: prompt-contract and approved frozen method assembly
diagnosis.result_layer: modeling-quality and independent acceptance missed defects
diagnosis.contribution: Incomplete method supply allowed reliance on role labels, a small set of Class/mapping definitions and long prose without demonstrating complete multiview analysis and coverage.
diagnosis.causal_limit: This identifies a concrete missing-input path and observed outcome; it does not prove one clause, GLM, low effort or quota alone caused the outcome, and does not establish any repaired-runtime PASS.

history.qualification: Commit locations identify history, not intent or an independently measured quality effect.

repair_targets: Supply a current-version approved method carrying multiview analysis, identity/granularity and shared-meaning responsibilities.
Supply the corresponding existing action/process/rule/interface semantic guidance.
Use existing semantic records for grounded perspective assessment and source-to-expression coverage.
Verify actual frozen/native method inputs, then independently evaluate actual model expressions.
Check exact governed read support for selected representations; the backend Operation detail family already exists.
boundaries: Do not enable arbitrary ambient Skills or load the whole legacy Runner.
Do not require seven Agents, seven outputs or a minimum node count.
Editing current method files does not retroactively alter frozen tasks/checkpoints.
No current model, CQ, budget, hidden evaluation or platform code was modified.

native_read_model_gap.qualification: Static allowlist gap. Context Query may still return Operation data; no new Operation or live Operation-read experiment performed.
